## Hinge question · Scalar or vector? {#iv7-hinge .vector-lesson .projection-lesson }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices"><p class="hinge-question">Given <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=6"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j}"></span>, which is the <strong>vector projection</strong> of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span>?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="\frac65"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="\frac65(3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j})"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="\frac6{25}(3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j})"></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="\frac6{25}"></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{b}|^2=25"></span>, so <span data-math="\operatorname{proj}_{\underset{\sim}{b}}\underset{\sim}{a}=\frac6{25}(3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j})"></span>.</div></div>
```
